notes.tagline: A small, scrappy Shopify storefront that has quietly built a programmatic-local engine. Their /pages/{city}-dispensary template prints 70% of their traffic — and every single page is catchable with better depth.

visual_system: Storefront aesthetic — green leaf palette, product-grid layouts, retail typography.
Stock cannabis imagery; minimal patient or clinician photography.
Shopify default UX patterns, fast load times, mobile-first.
'Shop' and 'dispensary' framing front-and-centre — closer to retail than clinical.
site_architecture: Single domain on Shopify — no patient portal, no help centre subdomain.
/pages/{city}-dispensary — ~95 templated city landing pages, the entire SEO engine.
/blogs/news — 53 editorial posts that rank but earn almost no traffic.
/pages/plant-medicine-doctors and a thin About / Process layer — no real clinical hub.
tone_compliance: Aggressive on consumer language — 'dispensary', 'weed', 'cannabis shop' in slugs and titles.
Higher CTR appeal on near-me queries; higher TGA exposure risk.
Author bylines absent or anonymous on blog posts — weak E-E-A-T.
Reviews live as inline testimonials rather than third-party embeds.

eeat.notes: Shopify gives them speed and a clean technical baseline, but the YMYL signals are thin: no MedicalCondition / MedicalWebPage schema, anonymous blog authorship, no visible medical-reviewer process. Their local pages convert on intent, not on trust.

steal.note: 83 city pages earn 580 visits / mo — the entire model. Replicate the template at suburb level for the top 5 metros, with proper clinical authority on top.
They walked into a geo vocabulary larger compliant clinics avoid. Use the same intent language in title tags + H1s without crossing TGA lines on body copy.
Their CWV is good because the platform forces it. Whatever stack we ship, match the load profile — every city page must feel instant.
Herbly under-uses schema; adding LocalBusiness / FAQ / MedicalBusiness markup to our city pages is a cheap CTR uplift in SERP features.
Sydney, Melbourne, Perth coverage is uneven for Herbly. The high-volume metros are wide open to a well-templated, clinically-anchored attack.
Herbly publishes one or the other (city page OR condition post). The crossover — 'medical cannabis for anxiety in Brisbane' — is uncontested high-intent inventory.

avoid.evidence: 53 /blogs/ posts earn 27 visits / mo total. Ranking but not winning — anonymous bylines, no medical reviewer, no freshness.
460 keywords at #51–100 produce zero traffic; another 286 at #21–50 produce 15. Three-quarters of the inventory is parked.
'Weed shop', 'cannabis shop' in /pages/ titles — higher CTR but real TGA risk. Don't copy the slugs verbatim.
131 condition keywords ranking earn 13 visits. Publishing into the space without credentials returns nothing.

implications: The template is the moat, not the brand — replicable in weeks with better depth.
Capital cities and suburb-level pSEO are wide open — Herbly only goes as deep as the regional / city level.
Clinical authority is the wedge — pair their template with our credentials and we out-rank page by page.
Their compliance exposure is our defence: stay clean on copy, win on E-E-A-T.

gap_matrix.comment: Thin About page only. Author it properly.
131 kw ranking → 13 visits. We win this with E-E-A-T.
Blog is dormant. Low bar to beat.
No subdomain. Long-tail informational is empty inventory.
